rationale: Three precise source-transfer questions: PSD vs nonnegative attention mass; reduced-state average vs exactH Pauli shell; Mercer operator-basis rotation vs a physical qubit basis transform. These decide whether source guarantees can transfer before task experiment.
amendment: Source-only scope extended to fixed synthetic native circuit ports and finite linear algebra only. No native full-head forward, task feature/checkpoint, optimizer, candidate search, source change, GPU/server/COS/model API.
exact_witness: Output X-basis +++ and --- prepared by legal last-layer RY angles +/-pi/2 through the existing CNOT ring; two-point input probabilities1/3 and2/3.
H_definition: SourceH kernel=sum_{Pauli exactweightH}rP*sP/sqrt(C(3,H)*3^H). PSD does not imply entrywise nonnegative.
S_definition: For probability-safe comparison only, arithmetic mean of S-subsystem HS overlaps. SourceS kernel is sqrt(C(3,S)) times this mean; no automatic rescaling/repair as a selected model.
gates: All40 query/all32 key/allH/allS identities retained; negative ports are not task statistics.
Exact identity or elementary rank/commutator counterexample is known tool, not newT.
Failure blocks only direct transplantation and sourceguarantee, not all local/projected quantum models.
No architecture/threshold/seed/weight rescue and no automatic fit.
